name: Rain Shadow
type_description: Effect / FM / Modulation - half-wave modulator, low parts count
bom_parts_summary: TL074 op-amp, CD4016 analog switch, VTL5C vactrol, resistors, 10nf cap, pot, jacks
components_evidence: BOM lists values/designators only (e.g. '10nf (1) C1', 'TL074 (1) U1'), no package or mounting type (DIP/SMD/THT) stated anywhere on the page

lineage.credit: "Rain Shadow is the standalone version of the half-wave modulator found in my Lynchian Device VCO. Based around a repurposed triangle-to-saw wave converter, Rain Shadow injects a modulation source into one half of the signal source waveform..."
lineage.source_is: Mechlab's own Lynchian Device module page - a eurorack VCO based on the Thomas Henry 8038 chip, from which Rain Shadow's half-wave modulator circuit was extracted as a standalone module
lineage.quote: the standalone version of the half-wave modulator found in my Lynchian Device VCO

notes: No HP or licence stated. BOM has no package/mounting info so components is null, not guessed. Lineage is to Mechlab's own earlier module, not a third-party design.
